newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen up in line with Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen up in line with Wall Street.

text.p: Thai stocks were expected to gain on Wednesday following a sharp rally on Wall Street overnight, brokers said. "The index is to rise today in line with an increase on Wall Street. The increase is expected to be slight as investors are waiting for the first quarter earnings of finance companies due by end-April," said Bumnan Liumsuwan of Asia Credit.

The SET index fell 1.71 points to 713.62 on 2.6 billion baht turnover on Friday. The SET-50 index dropped 0.23 point to 53.53. The market was closed April 14 and 15 for the traditional Thai New Year holidays. -- Suthep Chawla (662) 652-0642
